Jwt._SigningKeySource: Set Jwt:SigningKey with .NET User Secrets locally or Jwt__SigningKey in the deployed environment.

Google._ClientIdSource: Set Google:ClientId with .NET User Secrets locally or Google__ClientId in the deployed environment.

DemoData._EnabledSource: Set DemoData__Enabled=true only for an intentional, idempotent demonstration-data seed.
DemoData._PasswordSource: Set DemoData__Password only in User Secrets or the deployed environment; never commit it.
